messages.content:
You are a research manager proposing one bounded hyperparameter change.

Node: openml_breast_w
Description: OpenML breast-w (Breast Cancer Wisconsin), dataset ID 15: 699 rows, 9 features, binary target 'Class'. Frozen sklearn pipeline; only bounded config.yaml hyperparameters are editable.
Metric to optimize: val_auc (direction: maximize)
Files you may instruct the worker to edit: config.yaml
Budget index (trial number): 7
Current best val_auc: 0.991948

Editable values currently in config.yaml (use exact names):
  model_type = logistic_regression
  C = 0.3
  class_weight = balanced
  scaler = standard
  max_iter = 1000

Prior trial memory:
openml_breast_w__s105-trial-001: decision=kept; summary=increase-C-0.3; metric=0.991948; delta=None
openml_breast_w__s105-trial-002: decision=discarded; summary=increase-C-0.6; metric=0.991143; delta=-0.0008050000000000557
openml_breast_w__s105-trial-003: decision=discarded; summary=increase-C-0.6; metric=0.991143; delta=-0.0008050000000000557
openml_breast_w__s105-trial-004: decision=discarded; summary=increase-C-0.7; metric=0.991143; delta=-0.0008050000000000557
openml_breast_w__s105-trial-005: decision=discarded; summary=increase-C-0.8; metric=0.991143; delta=-0.0008050000000000557
openml_breast_w__s105-trial-006: decision=discarded; summary=increase-C-0.9; metric=0.991143; delta=-0.0008050000000000557

AVOIDANCE RULE (mandatory): Study the trial history above carefully.
Identify every hyperparameter that was already tried in the same direction (e.g. increasing BATCH_SIZE, reducing LEARNING_RATE) and produced no improvement or a failure. You MUST NOT propose the same parameter change in the same direction again.
Choose a DIFFERENT hyperparameter or a DIFFERENT direction than what has already been tried. If every direction for a parameter has been explored, switch to a completely different parameter.

Propose exactly one bounded experiment. Respond with ONLY a JSON object (no markdown fences, no extra text) with these six string fields:
  "summary"    — short slug (e.g. "reduce-lr-2e-4")
  "rationale"  — one sentence on why this might improve the metric
  "objective"  — complete worker instruction: "In config.yaml, change PARAM from OLD to NEW. Edit only config.yaml."
  "param"      — exact editable value name from the list above (e.g. "LEARNING_RATE")
  "old_value"  — current value as shown above (e.g. "5e-4")
  "new_value"  — proposed replacement value (e.g. "2e-4")

Constraints:
  - edit only: config.yaml
  - change exactly one listed value
  - param must be one of the editable values listed above
  - do not run the experiment; the harness runs it after your edit

Example: {"summary": "reduce-lr-2e-4", "rationale": "smaller lr often improves convergence on noisy signals", "objective": "In config.yaml, change LEARNING_RATE from 5e-4 to 2e-4. Edit only config.yaml.", "param": "LEARNING_RATE", "old_value": "5e-4", "new_value": "2e-4"}
